Why Join Us&nbsp;


	
	Be part of a growing company where your skills, commitment, and performance can contribute to business success and a healthier future for Africa.
	


Salary: N50,000 + performance-based sales commission

Method of Application

	Must reside in Ondo (Odigbo LGA)
	Must be willing to work in the field
	Good communication and observation skills
	Ability to follow instructions and submit accurate reports.


Salary

  "description": "Bravies Homz Limited is a real estate company based in Abuja, Nigeria, committed to delivering quality property solutions and creating valuable real estate investment opportunities. Driven by integrity, excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction, we are focused on building lasting relationships, delivering value, and contributing to the growth of the real estate sector in Nigeria and Across Africa

We are &nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Project Manager
Job Location: Abuja (FCT)
Employment Type: Full-time
Department: Projects / Engineering / Operations
Reports to: Managing Director / Head of Operations

Job Summary


	The Project Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, executing, and monitoring projects to ensure they are delivered within the approved scope, budget, timeline, and quality standards
	The successful candidate must have relevant experience managing engineering-related projects, coordinating technical teams, supervising contractors, monitoring project costs, and ensuring compliance with applicable technical, safety, and regulatory requirements
	The candidate must be able to coordinate stakeholders, identify project risks, resolve operational challenges, and provide regular progress reports to management


Key Responsibilities
Project Planning and Execution:


	Develop comprehensive project plans outlining scope, objectives, deliverables, timelines, budgets, and resource requirements
	Define project milestones and allocate responsibilities to team members and contractors
	Coordinate project activities from initiation through execution, monitoring, and completion
	Ensure that projects are delivered according to approved specifications and contractual requirements
	Monitor progress against the project schedule and take corrective action when delays occur


Engineering Project Coordination:


	Coordinate engineers, technical personnel, contractors, consultants, and other project stakeholders
	Review project drawings, technical specifications, work schedules, and related documentation with qualified technical personnel
	Monitor engineering work to ensure alignment with approved designs, specifications, and applicable standards
	Coordinate site activities, inspections, equipment requirements, and technical meetings where applicable
	Identify technical challenges and work with the relevant engineers to develop practical solutions
	Ensure that technical changes are properly reviewed, approved, documented, and communicated


Budget and Resource Management:


	Prepare and monitor project budgets, cost estimates, and expenditure reports
	Track project expenses and identify opportunities to control costs without compromising quality or safety
	Coordinate procurement requests, materials, equipment, and contractor requirements
	Monitor contractor performance, deliverables, and contractual obligations
	Report cost overruns, resource shortages, and potential financial risks to management


Risk, Quality, and Safety Management:


	Identify potential project risks and develop appropriate mitigation plans
	Monitor project quality and ensure that required inspections and quality assurance procedures are followed
	Ensure compliance with applicable health, safety, environmental, and engineering requirements
	Report incidents, safety concerns, quality issues, and significant project deviations promptly
	Maintain appropriate project risk registers and corrective action records


Communication and Reporting:


	Conduct project meetings and communicate responsibilities, deadlines, and progress updates
	Prepare weekly and monthly project reports for management
	Maintain accurate records of project plans, schedules, budgets, approvals, changes, and deliverables
	Communicate effectively with clients, consultants, suppliers, contractors, and internal departments
	Escalate major project risks, delays, disputes, and budget concerns to management
	Project Completion:
	Coordinate final inspections, testing, commissioning, and handover activities where applicable
	Confirm that outstanding defects and deliverables are addressed before project closure
	Prepare project completion reports and maintain relevant documentation
	Conduct project reviews to identify lessons learned and recommend improvements


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


	Percentage of projects completed within the approved timeline
	Percentage of projects delivered within budget
	Compliance with project scope and specifications
	Quality of project deliverables
	Number and severity of unresolved project issues
	Effectiveness of risk mitigation
	Contractor and stakeholder performance
	Accuracy and timeliness of project reports
	Compliance with applicable safety requirements
	Successful project handover and client satisfaction.


Qualifications and Experience


	Bachelor&rsquo;s degree or HND in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline
	Minimum of 5 years of relevant project management experience, preferably involving engineering projects
	Demonstrable experience coordinating technical teams, contractors, project schedules, and budgets
	Knowledge of project management methodologies, risk management, and quality control
	Proficiency in Microsoft Project, Primavera P6, or similar scheduling tools is an advantage
	Knowledge of AutoCAD, engineering drawings, or technical documentation is an advantage, depending on the project type
	Professional project management or relevant engineering certifications are desirable


Required Skills and Competencies


	Strong project planning and organisational skills
	Engineering project coordination experience
	Budgeting and cost control
	Risk assessment and problem-solving
	Leadership and stakeholder management
	Contract and contractor coordination
	Excellent communication and reporting skills
	Time management and decision-making
	Ability to manage multiple priorities
	Strong attention to quality, safety, and detail.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: almandinehrconsulting@gmail.com using the Job Position as the subject of the email.",

	A Sales Engineer role based in Port Harcourt, Rivers State, Nigeria, focused on flow measurement services and technical metering within the oil and gas sector.
	The position combines hands-on measurement engineering expertise with technical sales and client relationship work.


Responsibilities


	Deliver flow measurement services and technical support across metering inspection and audit activities.
	Carry out meter sizing calculations and design reviews for liquid and gas metering systems.
	Perform measurement uncertainty calculations to ensure accuracy and compliance.
	Conduct metering calibration and verification work in line with oil and gas process and measurement standards.
	Support technical sales efforts by translating client measurement requirements into appropriate solutions.
	Build and maintain client relationships, providing ongoing technical guidance and follow-up.
	Prepare technical documentation and reports for inspections, audits, and calibration activities.


Requirements
Required:


	5-10 years of experience in Flow Measurement Service and service role
	Experience in technical metering inspection and audit services
	Experience with meter sizing calculations, design reviews, and measurement uncertainty calculations for liquids and gas metering
	Experience with metering calibration and verification
	Experience with oil and gas process and measurement standards
	Experience in technical sales and client relations.


Preferred:


	Master’s degree
	Experience in the Oil & Gas Sector.
